{"schema_version":"4.3-requirement-extraction-v3.1.1","task_type":"requirement_extraction","status":"success","data":{"requirements":[{"category":"delivery","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C003-S003","start_ref":"C003-S003"},"text":"投标文件必须包含投标函。"},{"category":"delivery","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C003-S006","start_ref":"C003-S006"},"text":"投标文件必须包含开标一览表。"},{"category":"delivery","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C003-S007","start_ref":"C003-S007"},"text":"投标文件必须包含报价明细表。"},{"category":"delivery","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C003-S008","start_ref":"C003-S008"},"text":"投标文件必须包含详细配置一览表。"},{"category":"delivery","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C003-S009","start_ref":"C003-S009"},"text":"投标文件必须包含商务、技术要求响应及偏离表。"},{"category":"delivery","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C003-S010","start_ref":"C003-S010"},"text":"投标文件必须包含项目实施方案及需要说明的其他内容。"},{"category":"delivery","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C003-S011","start_ref":"C003-S011"},"text":"投标文件必须包含资格证明文件。"},{"category":"delivery","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C003-S012","start_ref":"C003-S012"},"text":"资格证明文件必须包含格式条款《关于资格的声明函》。"},{"category":"delivery","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C003-S014","start_ref":"C003-S013"},"text":"资格证明文件必须包含法定代表人授权委托书；法定代表人签署投标文件且亲自参与的必须提供《法定代表人亲自投标声明》。"},{"category":"delivery","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C003-S015","start_ref":"C003-S015"},"text":"授权委托人必须提供本单位连续6个月（且至少包含近3个月中任意1个月份<不含投标当月>）为其缴纳社保的证明扫描件。"},{"category":"delivery","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C003-S016","start_ref":"C003-S016"},"text":"投标文件可包含投标人认为需要提供的其他证明文件。"},{"category":"delivery","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C003-S018","start_ref":"C003-S018"},"text":"投标文件中加“*”的项目若有缺失或无效，将作为无效投标文件。"},{"category":"delivery","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C003-S021","start_ref":"C003-S019"},"text":"如资格证明文件遇年检、换证等未能提供的情况，必须提供法定年检、换证单位出具的有效证明；如遇国家相关政策规定可不具备的，必须提供相关政策规定或相关单位出具的有效证明。"},{"category":"delivery","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C003-S024","start_ref":"C003-S022"},"text":"授权委托人提供以人事代理、控股子公司等代收代缴形式缴纳社保的证明属于无效证明文件；新成立的单位若不能提供授权委托人的社保缴纳证明，可提供自成立以来的相关证明；新成立的单位是指营业执照颁发日期在本项目开标之日前六个月内。"},{"category":"delivery","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C003-S025","start_ref":"C003-S025"},"text":"投标文件构成资料为非中文时应提供中文译版。"},{"category":"delivery","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C003-S027","start_ref":"C003-S026"},"text":"招标文件要求提供证书证件等原件电子件的，投标人提供的电子件应是对证书证件等原件通过扫描、拍照等方式进行数字化的可被电子交易平台识别的数字文件。"},{"category":"delivery","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C003-S029","start_ref":"C003-S029"},"text":"联合体投标的，由联合体牵头单位编制、提交投标文件。"},{"category":"delivery","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C003-S030","start_ref":"C003-S030"},"text":"本项目不接受纸质投标文件。"}]},"warnings":[]}
